title: How big is a 1 carat trillion?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat trillion?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat trillion?
post.caption:
A 1 carat trillion measures about 7.0 by 7.0 millimeters. A 2 carat trillion covers 53% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Trillion diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/trillion-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
